recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, high-contrast portrait of a female subject with warm, golden-yellow lighting, set against a dark, textured background. The composition features a prominent horizontal black capsule graphic containing stylized lowercase typography, with secondary vertical text elements connected by fine lines.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's face and shoulder occupy the left two-thirds of the frame.
Warm yellow highlights on skin contrast against deep black shadows.
Horizontal graphic bar intersects the subject's torso to ground the typography.
Fine vertical and horizontal lines create a grid-like connection between text blocks.
coreInvariants: Golden-yellow monochromatic lighting on the subject.
Black pill-shaped horizontal container for the main title.
Lowercase serif and sans-serif font pairing.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait, subject angled slightly away from the camera, positioned off-center to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The black horizontal capsule bar in the lower third of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves down the arm to the main title bar, then follows the vertical lines to the secondary text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space on the right side and background provides room for secondary typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellow highlights; extreme value contrast between light and dark areas.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Lowercase serif for the primary name; geometric sans-serif for secondary details.
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a high-contrast serif with thin hairlines.
Secondary text uses wide-tracked, small-scale sans-serif.
Letters in the primary name overlap the graphic container.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'b' and 'y' in the primary name extend vertically beyond the capsule bar.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the name paired with a minimalist sans-serif for the title, connected by thin geometric lines.
graphicDevices: Horizontal black capsule with white border
Thin white vertical and horizontal connecting lines
Soft outer glow on primary text

preserve: Lowercase serif for the main name
avoid: Bright primary colors other than yellow

candidateDirections.reason: High contrast and elegant serifs match the primary name style.
Geometric sans-serif matches the secondary text and 90s aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A portrait of a woman with dark hair pulled back, wearing a light-colored tank top. The lighting is a strong, warm golden-yellow from the side, creating deep shadows. The background is dark and indistinct. Leave the lower third and right side clear for graphics.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a horizontal black capsule shape with a thin white border in the lower third. Place large lowercase serif text overlapping the left side of the capsule. Add small, wide-tracked sans-serif text on the right, connected to the capsule by a thin vertical white line.

verificationChecks: Is the main text in a lowercase serif font?
Does the black capsule ground the composition?
Are there thin connecting lines between text elements?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the yellow color cast
Width and position of the capsule bar
Font weight of the primary serif
Placement of the secondary text blocks
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the background.
Verify the golden-yellow glow is consistent across the skin tones.
Check that the capsule shape has a clean, rounded finish.
Confirm the vertical lines are perfectly straight and thin.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait with [Color] Chiaroscuro + [Shape] Graphic Overlay + [High-Contrast Serif] Typography.
